decisions.reason: Because this combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot directly extends our existing automation, controls, and plant-integration knowledge, our strong in-house R&D and service base give us good capacity to refine it and commercialize it in a growing market.

Because the automatic de-shuttering robot is closely related to our established precast production equipment and can be learned from and improved using our existing engineering, commissioning, and customer support capabilities, it should remain in the portfolio.

Because the profile storage robot complements our broad, integrated plant offering and relies on knowledge we already possess in materials handling, automation, and system planning, we are well positioned to absorb user feedback and improve its fit in customer plants.

Because the automatic shuttering robot builds squarely on our established machinery and control competences and offers a modular automation option alongside other robot variants, keeping it supports learning and market coverage in an expanding industry.
